text_block_list.text:
That day, Fenomeno was chasing after a 
delinquent student.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hold ooon!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hmph, as if anyone's gonna catch me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, hey?! Don't go climbing out the 
window!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, they slipped away from me once 
again, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Along with her swift legs, she has the 
cunning to adapt and choose from multiple 
escape routes depending on the situation.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Blindly chasing after it will make 
capturing it difficult... Let us devise a 
proper strategy here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Today of all days, I absolutely won't let 
you get away, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you morals committee types never 
learn, do ya? Fine by me, I'll play with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hop! Ha! Come on, what's wrong? Keep 
up!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Trying to shake me in the cafeteria 
crowd, are you...? In that case!)

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A dead end because of cleaning?! 
Dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, right on target! Now if I just 
corner them in this direction—)

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... Hehe, looks like you held 
on for a bit, but in the end, I'm the 
winner—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! No way, why are you here...! I 
always change my route, there's no way you 
could cut me off...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Indeed we can! I mapped out all of their 
previous escape routes and guided them 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No way... How could this be...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If we cut off each route one by one, your 
destination will naturally be decided. 
Now, give up peacefully!

From this day on, the sharpness of 
Fenomeno's running reached a whole new 
level.
